, Reason for Mistake: The WebSurfer surfaced and implicitly accepted an auto-generated DuckDuckGo snippet stating Clint Eastwood achieved success in the Western TV series Maverick. This is incorrect—Eastwood’s Western TV breakthrough was Rawhide (as Rowdy Yates), while Maverick is associated with James Garner. The error stemmed from relying on an unverified summary instead of corroborating with credible sources.
